missing.text: A fork makes two ways to win on the next turn. Look for a square that starts both paths.

Allosaurus was a meat-eating dinosaur with small horns above its eyes.
Ankylosaurus had bony armor and a heavy club at the end of its tail.
Brachiosaurus had front legs longer than its back legs.

Carnotaurus had two horns on top of its head and very small arms.
